name: Najeeb Ullah
headline: Machine Learning & AI Engineer | Building Manager, Karachi
bio: I am a Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in predictive modeling, deep learning architectures, and Generative AI systems using LangChain. My work encompasses exploratory data analysis, multi-model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and deployed Streamlit applications. In addition to engineering, I manage residential building operations in Karachi, handling tenant communications, utility tracking, maintenance documentation, and technical repair coordination.

professional_areas.title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning
professional_areas.description: Designs and trains end-to-end predictive systems, ensemble models, and neural architectures with rigorous cross-validation and clinical metric benchmarking.

professional_areas.title: LangChain & Generative AI
professional_areas.description: Constructs intelligent LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic document query engines, and agentic workflows.

professional_areas.title: Data Science & Exploratory Analytics
professional_areas.description: Executes population-scale health analytics, multi-collinearity checks, feature engineering, and high-dimensional distribution profiling.

professional_areas.title: Residential Building Management (Karachi)
professional_areas.description: Oversees comprehensive operations for a residential property: resident notices, utility-bill reconciliation, maintenance records, and repair coordination.
